claim_boundary: Coarse tags are unreviewed trace-sampling metadata only. They are not adequacy labels, motif labels, correctness judgments, or evidence of internal computation.
qualification_claim_boundary: This matched two-arm qualification jointly changes context presentation, reasoning effort, transport, and output ceiling from v1. It qualifies a complete v2 protocol and cannot by itself causally attribute changes to one factor. The full-unit-markup arm is intentionally large and noisy.

baselines.v2: the request and result bindings of the containing v2 bundle

normalization.tag_agreement: exact equality of the tag strings
normalization.confidence_agreement: exact equality of the confidence strings
normalization.boundary_agreement: exact equality of sorted unique boundary_concerns; boundary_note is excluded from this metric
normalization.exact_full_decision_agreement: exact value equality of tag, confidence, boundary_concerns in provider order, and boundary_note; unit_id is the pairing key and is excluded

comparisons.pairing: within each arm, pair each of the four repeat requests to its repeat_of_request_id and compare the same unit_id
pair target_only_markup and full_unit_markup primary requests by source_v1_request_id and compare the same unit_id
for each arm, pair every v2 primary request to its frozen v1 source_v1_request_id and compare the same unit_id
for each arm, pair every v2 repeat request to its frozen v1 source_v1_request_id and compare the same unit_id

required_reporting.agreement_counts: for every comparison and arm stratum where applicable, report expected, observed, eligible, missing, invalid, agreeing, and disagreeing unit-pair counts; never silently drop or zero-impute
required_reporting.confusion_matrices: report tag confusion matrices with frozen tag order and the first named side as rows; for cross_arm_primary also report confidence confusion and per-boundary-concern 2x2 presence matrices
required_reporting.usage_cost_by_arm: for each v2 arm, report physical request counts plus input, uncached-input, cache-read, cache-write, output, and reasoning token totals and missingness; report total USD cost and primary-versus-repeat strata
required_reporting.v1_usage_cost: report v1 usage and cost separately when frozen receipts permit it; do not impute unavailable components or interpret protocol cost differences causally

interpretation.threshold_note: No formal pass or fail threshold is predeclared for this qualification. Report descriptive results before deciding a downstream threshold.
interpretation.causal_attribution: The v2 versus v1 comparison jointly changes full-response context, markup, reasoning effort, Batch transport, and output ceiling; do not attribute a difference to any one change.
interpretation.human_blind_review: deferred and not part of this frozen automated comparison

tags.active_task_work: The unit actively carries out task-relevant work: transformation, retrieval, traversal, comparison, selection, counting, calculation, or state update.
tags.evaluation_or_revision: The unit primarily checks, verifies, corrects, backtracks, or reconsiders work, even if it contains task operations.
tags.intermediate_commitment: The unit primarily settles or reports a non-final result or state without substantial task operation in that same unit.
tags.final_answer: The unit states or serializes the final commitment.
tags.other_semantic_text: The unit plans, explains, restates, describes instructions, comments, or mentions a process without carrying it out.
tags.surface_or_control: The unit is only formatting, punctuation, whitespace/control, a tag, JSON syntax, or other structural material.
tags.uncertain: The unit's primary function or boundary is genuinely unresolved; do not force another tag.
